text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: Trainer... I lost again this time...

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
...Watching them made me realize. Their 
faces shine so brightly when they win.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
I love seeing everyone smile, but... as I 
thought, just watching from the sidelines 
is frustrating.
choice_data_list: Next time, I won't just be watching.

Let's do our best so we can laugh in the 
end!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
choice_data_list:
Let's grab a bite, then come up with a 
strategy.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
Once my tummy is full, I'll do my best 
again!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
...Hehe, yeah. You're right, I have to do 
my best and smile next time...!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
All right, time to say bye-bye to feeling 
sad! I'm gonna get stronger and stronger!
